item.title: ¿Por qué Trump mengua antes de tiempo?
item.description: Frente a lo admirable capacidad expeditiva del sistema parlamentario del Reino Unido a la hora de cambiar de gobierno, el sistema presidencialista de Estados Unidos tiene un ritmo de transición muchísimo más lento. De hecho, durante el periodo que abarca entre las elecciones de medio mandato –previstas para el próximo 3 de noviembre– y la toma de posesión de un nuevo presidente dos años después, los ocupantes de la Casa Blanca son conocidos como 'lame ducks' (patos cojos) , una metáfora de su capitidisminuido poder y de su cada vez más evidente fecha de caducidad. item.title: Evicted 87-year-old Spanish pensioner to return home after deal
item.description: An 87-year-old Madrid pensioner whose eviction became a rallying point for Spain’s housing protests will be able to return home after reaching a deal with the property’s owners, her lawyer said Monday. The agreement comes as demonstrations across the country pile pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s government to address soaring rents, a shortage of affordable homes and weak tenant protections. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: In the US-China AI race, the real fight is keeping humans in control
item.description: The US-China AI competition faces a dilemma. Both countries see artificial intelligence as a source of economic, scientific and strategic power, so neither has much incentive to slow down. Yet the more capable and autonomous AI becomes, the more important the question of human control. Last week’s summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping brought that tension into the open. Trump wants to leave AI “exactly where it is” rather than add new guardrails, while Xi... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Sweden’s Magdalena Andersson ends government-formation talks with no result
item.description: Sweden’s election winner Magdalena Andersson said she is not currently able to form a government, underscoring the difficulty of building a coalition in the fragmented parliament after the election earlier this month. The Social Democrat leader returned her mandate to explore forming a government after the Left Party decided to support a centre-right candidate for parliament speaker in a vote later on Monday, she told reporters. The move does not necessarily mean Andersson will not be the next... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: China resuming US coal imports among thin list of summit outcomes
item.description: China agreed to import at least 10 million tonnes of US coal in each of the next two years, marking one of the few concrete results from President Xi Jinping’s state visit to the United States. The country will also lower tariffs on 1,619 US products, including coal, under a deal to reduce levies on US$30 billion of non-sensitive goods shipped in each direction, according to a White House statement. Other items include agricultural goods, cosmetics and medical devices. The US will cut levies on... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş on trial for insulting President Erdoğan in standup show
item.description: Göktaş's arrest was the latest in a widening crackdown on anyone seen as critical of Turkey's conservative government or its values, which has netted hundreds of politicians, artists, musicians, journalists and LGBTQ+ activists. Fuente: Euronews.
